title: rbac-v2: enforce KMS region residency + audit logging hardening
author: Samantha Lee
description: Enforce KMS region residency constraints in RBAC v2 and add audit logging for residency enforcement decisions. Motivation: customers in regulated regions require that keys and decrypted material never leave pinned regions; existing RBAC v2 allowed KMS references without region checks which led to a compliance gap. This PR implements server-side policy enforcement for KMS key region pinning, augments audit logs with decision context (policy id, matched rule, evaluated attributes, fallback/resolution path), provides a migration path for existing policies, and hardens validation in the API surface. Changes include a policy evaluator extension to check kms:key resource attributes against role-scoped residency rules; API validation to reject incompatible policy assignments unless a migration-ack flag is set; an opt-in strict mode feature flag for early adopters; test coverage (unit + integration + e2e); docs and changelog updates. Checklist: implement evaluator and schema changes; add audit log fields and structured event types; migration script and datafix; backward-compatible feature-flag gated rollout; tests and CI; documentation and release notes. Related: ENG-1423 for policy schema work, SEC-98 for compliance acceptance criteria, SUP-412 customer report.
commit_summaries: Add kms residency matcher to rbac policy evaluator (core/runtime): evaluate kms:key.region against policy.residency.allowed_regions
Add structured audit events for residency decisions and rationale (audit-logger): include policy_id, rule_id, principal, resource_attrs, decision, reason
API validation: reject policy assignments referencing cross-region KMS keys unless migration-ack provided
Migration: add datafix script to annotate legacy policies with inferred residency metadata and a CLI migration helper
Feature flag: rbac.strict_kms_residency (default: off) and rollout gating logic
Tests: unit tests for evaluator, integration tests for API path, e2e sim exercising migration and audit events
patch_snippet:
--- a/redwood/infra/rbac/evaluator/kms_residency.go
+++ b/redwood/infra/rbac/evaluator/kms_residency.go
@@ -1,6 +1,28 @@
+// Reject if key.region not in allowed regions from policy rule
+func checkKMSResidency(policyRule, resource) bool {
+  region := resource.Attrs["kms.region"]
+  return contains(policyRule.AllowedRegions, region)
+}

release_notes: Enforce KMS key region residency for RBAC v2 policies with audit logging of enforcement decisions. Migration helper provided; rollout is feature-flag gated. Admins should run the migration helper to annotate legacy policies or enable migration-ack to allow assignment during a controlled rollout.
